units.source_text: “白130是败着，这一手匆忙下在‘17·九’位上，才是对黑的回应。

en.t: White 130 was the losing move; hastily playing this move at the '17-9' point was actually the proper answer to Black.

units.source_text: 比如黑应在‘17·八’位上，那么白130就是正确的了。

en.t: For example, if Black had answered at the '17-8' point, then White 130 would have been correct.

units.source_text: 这就是说，黑即使接着131长，白也不必考虑黑‘16·十二’位上，可以在‘12·十一’位上悠闲自在地探头。

en.t: In other words, even if Black then extended with 131, White would not need to worry about Black at the '16-12' point, and could leisurely poke out at the '12-11' point.

units.source_text: 此外，即使看到什么变化，局势要比棋谱复杂得多，是一场极其微妙的争夺战。

en.t: Moreover, whatever variations one considers, the position was far more complicated than the game record suggests, an extremely delicate struggle.

units.source_text: 受到黑133之后的强硬一断，正是白子的隐患。

en.t: The forceful cut after Black 133 was precisely the hidden danger for White's stones.

units.source_text: 后来虽然力争平息，但狂澜既倒，无法挽回了。”

en.t: Although White later fought hard to calm the situation, the great wave had already collapsed and could no longer be turned back.
